verdict.rationale: Splitting a sale across multiple payment methods or payers is a fair question for an in-person payments product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents split-tender or split-payer support. The cited features (tipping, offline storage, receipts, refunds, custom POS integration via SDKs) are adjacent capabilities or developer building blocks and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a merchant-ops user, I can split a single sale across multiple payment methods or payers
